predictions.articleTitle: Iraq vs Iran Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Arnold's Youth Break Iran's Defense? — Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Iran's superior Elo pedigree and second-half attacking depth make Draw / Away Win alongside Under 2.5 Goals the optimal projection in Basra.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win — Iran's second-half quality targets Iraq's scoring drought while home discipline preserves draw coverage (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals — Combined 2.25 goal lambda and Iraq's five blanks in six matches point to a low-scoring final (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
0:0 Goalless Stalemate Contingency — Compact Iraqi home defense could hold a Taremi-less Iranian attack level throughout (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Second-half Iranian quality tests Iraq's Basra home resistance in low-scoring final

spf.comment: Covers both Iran's late 0:1 breakthrough via bench depth and a disciplined 1:1 Basra draw, as neither a solo away win nor a standalone draw adequately prices both Taremi's absence and Iraq's scoring slump.

over_under.comment: Backed by a 2.25 combined goal lambda, Iraq's 0.15 decayed goals-for average, and Iran's 42.9% clean-sheet rate.

score.comment: 0:1 reflects Iran's second-half bench superiority over an exhausted Iraq attack, while 1:1 covers Iraq exploiting Iran's goalkeeper rotation.

goals.comment: 1 and 2 total goals account for over half of the independent Poisson goal distribution and match tight final dynamics.

bqc.comment: Iran scores 64.3% of its goals after halftime, pointing to a level break before either an Iranian winner or a full-time stalemate.
